name: Annie
title: the Dark Child

Q.name: Disintegrate
Q.description: Annie hurls a fireball, dealing 80/125/170/215/260 + 0.8×AP magic damage. If the target dies, Annie refunds the Mana cost and reduces the Cooldown by 50%.
Q.summary: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.

W.name: Incinerate
W.description: Annie projects a wave of fire, dealing 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.8×AP magic damage.
W.summary: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

E.name: Molten Shield
E.description: Annie grants an ally champion 60/95/130/165/200 + 0.4×AP Shield for 3 seconds and 0.2–0.5 (by level) Decaying Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. While the shield holds, enemies who hit the shielded ally with an Attack or Ability receive 25/35/45/55/65 + 0.4×AP magic damage once per shield. Tibbers always gains the effects of Molten Shield when summoned.
E.summary: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.

R.name: Summon: Tibbers
R.description: Passive: Annie gains 10/15/20% Magic Penetration. Annie summons her bear Tibbers, dealing 150/275/400 + 0.75×AP magic damage. For the next 45 seconds, Tibbers burns nearby enemies for 10/15/20 + 0.04×AP magic damage per second. Tibbers becomes enraged when summoned, if Annie stuns an enemy champion, and if Annie dies. When enraged, Tibbers gains 275% Attack Speed and 100% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds. Recast: Manually issue orders to Tibbers.
R.summary: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

Passive.name: Pyromania
Passive.description: After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target. Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.
Passive.summary: After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target. Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Burst mage whose passive stuns after 4 spells and whose R summons Tibbers. She sets up kills with a stored stun.
strengths: R AoE stun with stored passive
profile.curveNote: Plays around the passive stun counter: a stored stun is her trade window.
